Barron McCann, a technology services specialist, has acquired a majority stake in Retail247 and is a trusted provider of IT requirements for clients in retail, hospitality, leisure, and corporate sectors. Barron's, the investing publication, is published by Dow Jones & Company and provides analysis and advice on various investment options.
